project_demands.projectDescription: Building an AI-assisted retail banking portal: a Next.js and TypeScript front end over existing Java/Spring Boot microservices, with a Gemini-powered assistant for customer servicing, product discovery and internal advisor copilots.
project_demands.rawJobDescription:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer — NorthBridge Financial Group (Digital Banking & AI Engineering)

ABOUT THE ENGAGEMENT
NorthBridge is modernising its retail banking experience. The existing estate is a mature Java/Spring Boot microservices platform exposing REST APIs over SQL data stores. We are layering an AI-assisted experience on top of it: a Next.js + TypeScript front end, and a Gemini-powered assistant that helps customers self-serve and helps advisors answer faster. You will work directly with the client's platform team through interview, onboarding and delivery.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Extend and harden Java / Spring Boot microservices that expose banking domain capabilities as REST APIs.
- Build the customer and advisor experience in Next.js with enterprise-grade TypeScript, replacing legacy React screens incrementally.
- Integrate the Gemini API for retrieval-grounded assistance: prompt design, tool/function calling, streaming responses, and guardrails against hallucinated financial advice.
- Design retrieval over customer and product data, including embedding storage and query patterns in PostgreSQL.
- Own service reliability: observability, CI/CD, and performance budgets for AI-assisted endpoints.
- Pair with the client's engineers and take part in architecture and design reviews.

ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE
- 6+ years building production backend services in Java and Spring Boot.
- Strong microservices and REST API design; comfortable with SQL data modelling.
- Production React experience, and readiness to move to Next.js App Router patterns.
- Working knowledge of enterprise TypeScript in a typed, reviewed codebase.
- Hands-on integration of an LLM API (Gemini preferred) into a real product surface.

DESIRABLE
- Banking or financial services delivery exposure and awareness of regulatory constraints.
- Vector search / embedding optimisation in PostgreSQL (pgvector or equivalent).
